reason: I'll make the break first so the platelet plug has a place to form, as the introduction describes.
expectation: I expect a small cut in the skin and blood vessel, though I'm not sure what the game will show next.

alternatives.reason: I also considered making the reinforcing threads first, but wanted to see the injury they will help seal.

effect: The cut is leaking, so I'll work on the platelet plug first.
reaction: The narrowed vessel still leaking makes the need for a plug clear.
reason: Platelets gather at the damaged vessel to help stop the leak.
expectation: I expect the platelets to form a plug at the cut, possibly without fully reinforcing it yet.

alternatives.reason: The clotting proteins can make reinforcing threads, but I want to form the plug first.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak; it still needs reinforcing threads.
reaction: Seeing the platelets pile up makes their job clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the enzyme label says it helps the protein form threads.
expectation: I expect clotting threads to form, though they may need a separate step to reinforce the plug.

effect: The protein formed a mesh, and the new goal is to stop the bleeding.
reaction: The branching mesh makes it easier to picture how the plug could be reinforced.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it brings the threads together with the platelet plug.
expectation: I expect the mesh to reinforce the plug and stop the bleeding.

effect: The mesh stopped the bleeding, but the open skin still needs to heal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the plug reinforced, and the unhealed skin makes the limit of this repair clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the threads to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: it showed how the two parts work together to stop bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the protein threads was a little predictable because it was the only offered combination, though the mesh picture helped explain it.

surprise.text: The vessel was sealed while the skin above it remained open; stopping bleeding is not the same as healing the cut.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The enzyme label explained why it paired with the clotting protein, although I followed that hint rather than knowing the details.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the open skin heals. The chapter ended with that question still unresolved.
